title: 直接映射 Cache：地址切分与逐条命中判定
expected_output:
=== direct-mapped cache ===
  capacity 1024 B, block 16 B -> 64 lines
  address split: tag = bits 31:10, index = bits 9:4, offset = bits 3:0

  address    tag  index  offset   result
  0x0000       0      0       0   MISS
  0x0010       0      1       0   MISS
  0x0020       0      2       0   MISS
  0x0000       0      0       0   HIT
  0x0400       1      0       0   MISS
  0x0410       1      1       0   MISS
  0x0000       0      0       0   MISS
  0x0010       0      1       0   MISS
  0x0800       2      0       0   MISS
  0x0810       2      1       0   MISS
  0x0000       0      0       0   MISS

hits=1 misses=10  hit rate=9.1%

reading the trace:
  0x0000 is revisited immediately -> HIT (temporal locality)
  0x0400 has the same index 0 as 0x0000 -> it evicts it, and the next 0x0000 MISSES
  0x0800 also lands on index 0 -> three blocks fight over one line
  that is a CONFLICT miss: a 2-way set-associative cache would remove it entirely
